design_philosophy.theme_direction: Monokrom Editorial meets Indonesian Brass & Champagne Warmth. Moves away from tacky AI rose-gold slop into cinematic magazine aesthetics with high contrast typography, warm neutrals, and crisp tactile borders.
core_principles: Editorial First: Cinematic imagery cards with generous ratios, asymmetric editorial headers, and warm ivory/champagne canvas

Adat Cultural Honor: Explicit, rich visual tags and specialized filtering for Indonesian traditional ceremonies (Sunda Siger, Jawa Paes Ageng, Minang Suntiang, Bali Payas Agung, Batak Frankness, Chinese Teapai, Modern Minimalist)
WhatsApp-First Frictionless Lead Flow: One-click primary CTA to WhatsApp with pre-filled context (Vendor name, Event Date, City, Guest Count, Package ID)
Indonesian Financial Transparency: Clear IDR formatting (e.g., Rp 150.000.000) with budget distribution breakdown across traditional vs modern expense categories

scale.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-[1.1]
scale.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug
scale.h3_card: text-xl sm:text-2xl font-serif font-medium text-amber-950 dark:text-amber-100
scale.body_lead: text-base sm:text-lg font-sans font-light text-stone-600 dark:text-stone-300 leading-relaxed
scale.body_default: text-sm sm:text-base font-sans font-normal text-stone-700 dark:text-stone-300 leading-normal
scale.overline_tag: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] font-semibold text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-400

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_rules: Use asymmetric ratios (e.g. col-span-12 lg:col-span-8 vs col-span-12 lg:col-span-4). Avoid uniform equal square grids. Always set padding inside bordered containers to prevent edge collisions.

whatsapp_cta.button_style: inline-flex items-center gap-2 px-5 py-2.5 rounded-md bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium text-sm transition-all duration-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
whatsapp_cta.behavior: Opens WhatsApp Web/App directly with localized pre-filled message template in Indonesian.

dual_language.toggle_component: Supports ID (Bahasa Indonesia) and EN (English) with seamless i18n key switching.

testing_and_qa.data_testid_convention: All interactive elements, buttons, inputs, links, tabs, and filters MUST include a role-based kebab-case data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Load Google Fonts Cormorant Garamond, Plus Jakarta Sans, and JetBrains Mono in public/index.html or src/index.css
Ensure all components are built in JS/JSX files (.js / .jsx) as configured in the frontend repository
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive controls (buttons, modals, tabs, filters, inputs)
Maintain high contrast text compliance (minimum 4.5:1 ratio for body text)
Apply the editorial layout and WhatsApp-first lead funnel across all vendor cards and profile detail pages
